```{r}
# pooled theta and ee value-sensitivity analysis

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(sandwich)
library(lmtest)
library(marginaleffects)

study1_nodes_file  <- "D:/Birmingham_Uni_Oct25/esaddm/studies/study1/results/esaddm_z/fits/esaddm_z_study1_posterior_summary_all_nodes.csv"
study2_nodes_file  <- "D:/Birmingham_Uni_Oct25/esaddm/studies/study2/results/esaddm_z/fits/esaddm_z_study2_posterior_summary_all_nodes.csv"
study1_slopes_file <- "D:/Birmingham_Uni_Oct25/Eye_Tracking_Project/Study1/results/tables/behav/Study1_Garcia_ParticipantSlopes.csv"
study2_slopes_file <- "D:/Birmingham_Uni_Oct25/Eye_Tracking_Project/Study2/results/tables/behav/Study2_Garcia_ParticipantSlopes.csv"
output_dir         <- "D:/Birmingham_Uni_Oct25/esaddm/inter_individual"


# get model coefficients

read_coefficient <- function(nodes, parameter) {

  pattern <- paste0("^", parameter, "_subj\\.[0-9]+$")
  values <- nodes[grepl(pattern, nodes$node), c("node", "mean")]
  values$sub_id <- as.integer(sub(".*_subj\\.", "", values$node))
  values$mean <- as.numeric(values$mean)
  names(values)[2] <- parameter
  values[, c("sub_id", parameter)]
}


read_model <- function(file) {
  
  nodes <- read.csv(file, check.names = FALSE)
  names(nodes)[1] <- "node"
  attended <- read_coefficient(nodes, "v_attention_w")
  unattended <- read_coefficient(nodes, "v_inattention_w")
  attended_contrast <- read_coefficient(nodes, "v_attention_contrast")
  unattended_contrast <- read_coefficient(nodes, "v_inattention_contrast")

  parameters <- attended %>%
    inner_join(unattended, by = "sub_id") %>%
    inner_join(attended_contrast, by = "sub_id") %>%
    inner_join(unattended_contrast, by = "sub_id")

  # check that no participant was lost when joining coefficients
  expected_n <- nrow(attended)

  if (nrow(parameters) != expected_n ||
      nrow(unattended) != expected_n ||
      nrow(attended_contrast) != expected_n ||
      nrow(unattended_contrast) != expected_n) {
    stop("participant ids differ across model coefficients")
  }

  parameters <- parameters %>%
    mutate(
      b_as = v_attention_w + v_attention_contrast / 2,
      b_ae = v_attention_w - v_attention_contrast / 2,
      b_is = v_inattention_w + v_inattention_contrast / 2,
      b_ie = v_inattention_w - v_inattention_contrast / 2,

      theta_s = b_is / b_as,
      theta_e = b_ie / b_ae
    ) %>%
    select(sub_id, theta_s, theta_e)

  parameters
}


# read EE slopes

read_ee_slopes <- function(file) {

  slopes <- read.csv(file)
  stopifnot(all(c("sub_id", "phase", "slope") %in% names(slopes)))

  slopes <- slopes %>%
    filter(toupper(trimws(phase)) == "EE") %>%
    transmute(
      sub_id = as.integer(sub_id),
      ee_slope = as.numeric(slope)
    )

  slopes
}


# match participants separately for each study

match_study <- function(nodes_file, slopes_file, study_name) {

  model_data <- read_model(nodes_file)
  slope_data <- read_ee_slopes(slopes_file)
  matched <- inner_join(model_data, slope_data, by = "sub_id")
  message(study_name, ": ", nrow(matched), " participants matched")
  matched %>%
    mutate(study = study_name, .before = 1)
}


study1 <- match_study(study1_nodes_file, study1_slopes_file, "study1")

study2 <- match_study(study2_nodes_file, study2_slopes_file, "study2")

data <- bind_rows(study1, study2) %>%
  mutate(study = factor(study, levels = c("study1", "study2"))) %>%
  arrange(study, sub_id)

# check sample size
stopifnot(
  nrow(study1) == 21,
  nrow(study2) == 20,
  nrow(data) == 41,
  !anyDuplicated(data[c("study", "sub_id")])
)

write.csv(data, file.path(output_dir, "matched_participants.csv"), row.names = FALSE)


# standardise within each study 

data <- data %>%
  group_by(study) %>%
  mutate(
    ee_slope_z = as.numeric(scale(ee_slope)),
    theta_s_z = as.numeric(scale(theta_s)),
    theta_e_z = as.numeric(scale(theta_e))
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# pooled regression 
model <- lm(ee_slope_z ~ theta_s_z + theta_e_z + study, data = data)

# hc3 robust standard errors - small sample
robust_cov <- sandwich::vcovHC(model, type = "HC3")
robust_test <- lmtest::coeftest(model, vcov. = robust_cov)

print(robust_test)
parameters <- c("theta_s_z", "theta_e_z")

results <- data.frame(
  parameter = c("theta_s", "theta_e"),
  beta = robust_test[parameters, "Estimate"],
  se = robust_test[parameters, "Std. Error"],
  p = robust_test[parameters, "Pr(>|t|)"],
  row.names = NULL
)

critical_t <- qt(0.975, df.residual(model))

results$ci_low <- results$beta - critical_t * results$se
results$ci_high <- results$beta + critical_t * results$se


# direct difference between theta_s and theta_e

difference <- coef(model)["theta_s_z"] - coef(model)["theta_e_z"]

difference_se <- sqrt(
  robust_cov["theta_s_z", "theta_s_z"] +
  robust_cov["theta_e_z", "theta_e_z"] -
  2 * robust_cov["theta_s_z", "theta_e_z"]
)

difference_p <- 2 * pt(
  -abs(difference / difference_se),
  df.residual(model)
)

results <- bind_rows(
  results,
  data.frame(
    parameter = "theta_s_minus_theta_e",
    beta = unname(difference),
    se = unname(difference_se),
    p = unname(difference_p),
    ci_low = unname(difference - critical_t * difference_se),
    ci_high = unname(difference + critical_t * difference_se)
  )
)

# overall regression r-squared
model_r2 <- summary(model)$r.squared

results$n <- nrow(data)
results$model_r2 <- model_r2

write.csv(
  results,
  file.path(output_dir, "theta_ee_results.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

print(results, row.names = FALSE, digits = 3)
cat("overall model R-squared:", round(model_r2, 3), "\n")


# each plot shows the association after accounting for study and the other theta coefficient

study_effect <- ifelse(
  data$study == "study2",
  coef(model)["studystudy2"],
  0
)

# symbolic theta remove experiential theta contribution
data$ee_adjusted_s <- data$ee_slope_z -
  coef(model)["theta_e_z"] * data$theta_e_z -
  study_effect

# experiential theta remove symbolic theta contribution
data$ee_adjusted_e <- data$ee_slope_z -
  coef(model)["theta_s_z"] * data$theta_s_z -
  study_effect


# function for figures 
make_plot <- function(x_column, y_column, model_term,
                      title, x_label, filename) {

  # observed data, adjusted for study and the other theta
  plot_data <- data.frame(
    x = data[[x_column]],
    y = data[[y_column]]
  )

  # hold other predictors at zero
  prediction_data <- data.frame(
    theta_s_z = rep(0, 100),
    theta_e_z = rep(0, 100),
    study = factor(rep("study1", 100), levels = levels(data$study))
  )

  prediction_data[[model_term]] <- seq(
    min(data[[x_column]]),
    max(data[[x_column]]),
    length.out = 100
  )

  # fitted values and 95% confidence intervals
  predictions <- marginaleffects::predictions(
    model,
    newdata = prediction_data,
    vcov = robust_cov,
    df = df.residual(model)
  )

  line_data <- data.frame(
    x = prediction_data[[model_term]],
    y = predictions$estimate,
    lower = predictions$conf.low,
    upper = predictions$conf.high
  )

  # regression statistics
  parameter <- ifelse(model_term == "theta_s_z", "theta_s", "theta_e")
  result <- results[results$parameter == parameter, ]

  p_label <- ifelse(result$p < 0.001, "< .001", sprintf("%.3f", result$p))

  stats_label <- sprintf("b = %.2f\np = %s", result$beta, p_label)

  # figure
  figure <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x, y)) +
    geom_ribbon(
      data = line_data,
      aes(x = x, ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      fill = "#267CB8", alpha = 0.18
    ) +
    geom_line(
      data = line_data,
      aes(x = x, y = y),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      colour = "#267CB8", linewidth = 1.1
    ) +
    geom_point(
      colour = "#267CB8", size = 2.9, alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text", x = -Inf, y = Inf,
      label = stats_label,
      hjust = -0.08, vjust = 1.1, size = 6
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = x_label,
      y = "EE Value-sensitivity Slope"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 18),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 18)
    )

  print(figure)

  ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0(filename, ".png")),
         figure, width = 6, height = 4.3, dpi = 450, bg = "white")

  ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0(filename, ".pdf")),
         figure, width = 6, height = 4.3,
         device = "pdf", useDingbats = FALSE)
}



make_plot(
  x_column = "theta_s_z",
  y_column = "ee_adjusted_s",
  model_term = "theta_s_z",
  title = "symbolic",
  x_label = expression(theta[S]),
  filename = "theta_s_ee_slope"
)

make_plot(
  x_column = "theta_e_z",
  y_column = "ee_adjusted_e",
  model_term = "theta_e_z",
  title = "experiential",
  x_label = expression(theta[E]),
  filename = "theta_e_ee_slope"
)

cat("\nanalysis completed. files saved to:\n", output_dir, "\n")

```
